title.zh: 授权拨款16916683比索，依第842号共和国法规定为公立学校局公立学校官员、教师及其他学校人员及Welfareville教师的薪金调整与自动加薪
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of the Sum of Sixteen Million Nine Hundred Sixteen Thousand Six Hundred Eighty-Three Pesos for Salary Adjustments and Automatic Salary Increases of Public School Officials, Teachers and Other School Personnel of the Bureau of Public Schools and Welfareville Teachers in Accordance with the Provisions of Republic Act Numbered Eight Hundred Forty-Two

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1155_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of sixteen million nine hundred sixteen thousand six hundred eighty-three pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby authorized to be appropriated of funds in the National Treasury not o otherwise appropriated, for salary adjustments and automatic salary increases of public school officials, teachers and other school personnel of the Bureau of Public Schools and Welfareville teachers in accordance with the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Eight hundred forty-two. Said sum shall thereafter be included in the annual General Appropriation Act.

This Act shall take effect on July first, nineteen hundred and fifty-four.
Approved: June 17, 1954.
